    AppDependencies
    | where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
    | where Name startswith "POST" and Name contains "/rtpactivator/activations"
    | distinct OperationId;

let deps =
    AppDependencies
    | where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
    | where Name startswith "POST" and Name contains "/rtpactivator/activations"
    | extend JWT_Subject = tostring(Properties["Request-X-JWT-Subject"])
    | summarize JWT_Subject = any(JWT_Subject) by OperationId;

AppRequests
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where AppRoleName == "rtp-activator"
| where Name startswith "POST" and Name contains "activations"
| join kind=inner validOps on OperationId
| join kind=leftouter deps on OperationId
| extend JWT_Subject = iif(isempty(JWT_Subject), "UNKNOWN", JWT_Subject)
| where $__contains(JWT_Subject, $activator_subject)
| summarize Conteggio = count() by StatusCode = ResultCode
| evaluate pivot(StatusCode, sum(Conteggio))

panels.description: Motivo: eccezione Java se presente, altrimenti il log di warning/errore più grave della stessa richiesta (AppTraces). Gli id sono sostituiti da <id> per raggruppare.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
let validOps = 
    AppDependencies
    | where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
    | where Name startswith "POST" and Name contains "/rtpactivator/activations"
    | distinct OperationId;

let deps =
    AppDependencies
    | where Name startswith "POST" and Name contains "/rtpactivator/activations"
    | extend JWT_Subject = tostring(Properties["Request-X-JWT-Subject"])
    | summarize JWT_Subject = any(JWT_Subject) by OperationId;

let ex =
    union
        (AppExceptions
         | where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
         | where AppRoleName == "rtp-activator"
         | project OperationId, Livello = toint(4), Testo = InnermostMessage),
        (AppTraces
         | where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
         | where AppRoleName == "rtp-activator"
         | where SeverityLevel >= 2
         | project OperationId, Livello = toint(SeverityLevel), Testo = Message)
    | summarize arg_max(Livello, Testo) by OperationId
    | extend Testo = replace_regex(Testo, @"[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}", "<id>")
    | extend Breve = extract(@"^(WebExchangeBindException: Validation failed for argument at index \d+)", 1, Testo)
    | extend InnermostMessage = iif(isnotempty(Breve), Breve, Testo)
    | project OperationId, InnermostMessage;

AppRequests
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where AppRoleName == "rtp-activator"
| where Name startswith "POST" and Name contains "activations"
| join kind=inner validOps on OperationId
| where ResultCode == "400"
| project OperationId, TimeGenerated, Name
| join kind=leftouter deps on OperationId
| join kind=leftouter ex on OperationId
| extend JWT_Subject = iif(isempty(JWT_Subject), "UNKNOWN", JWT_Subject)
| extend Motivo = iif(isempty(InnermostMessage), "N/A", InnermostMessage)
| where $__contains(JWT_Subject, $activator_subject)
| summarize Conteggio = count() by ["Service Provider"]=JWT_Subject, Motivo
| order by Conteggio desc

| where AppRoleName == "rtp-activator"
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where Message has "Error during activation process for SP"
| where Message has "Authenticated user doesn't have permission to perform this action"
| extend props = todynamic(Properties)

| extend bodySpId = extract(@"Error during activation process for SP\s+([^:]+):", 1, Message)

| where tokenSpId != bodySpId
| summarize ['Error Count'] = count()
  by ['Token SP ID'] = tokenSpId, ['Body SP ID'] = bodySpId
| order by ['Error Count'] desc

panels.title: ❌ Distribuzione Errori per Subject e Status Code

panels.description: Conteggi per richiesta (OperationId), non per riga di log. Mai usati = generati - completati - tentativi con OTP scaduto nel periodo. Gli OTP che scadono senza che nessuno provi a usarli non producono log: restano tra i mai usati. Un OTP generato poco prima della fine del periodo e usato dopo risulta ancora mai usato. I subentri falliti sono tentativi: quelli con OTP inesistente non consumano un OTP generato.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
let eventi =
    AppTraces
    | where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
    | where AppRoleName == 'rtp-activator'
    | extend Evento = case(
        Message startswith "Payer already exists, generating takeover OTP", "generato",
        Message startswith "Payer taken over with new id:", "completato",
        Message startswith "Error taking over payer: Wrong redeemer subject", "fallito_subject",
        Message startswith "Error taking over payer:", "fallito",
        Message startswith "OTP expired due to expiration time exceeded", "scaduto",
        Message startswith "Request rejected due to nonexistent OTP", "inesistente",
        "")
    | where isnotempty(Evento)
    | summarize Eventi = make_set(Evento) by OperationId
    | extend Fallito = set_has_element(Eventi, "fallito") or set_has_element(Eventi, "fallito_subject");
eventi
| summarize
    Generati = countif(set_has_element(Eventi, "generato")),
    Completati = countif(set_has_element(Eventi, "completato")),
    Scaduti = countif(set_has_element(Eventi, "scaduto")),
    Falliti = countif(Fallito),
    FallitiInesistente = countif(Fallito and set_has_element(Eventi, "inesistente")),
    FallitiScaduto = countif(Fallito and set_has_element(Eventi, "scaduto")),
    FallitiSubject = countif(set_has_element(Eventi, "fallito_subject"))
| extend
    MaiUsati = max_of(Generati - Completati - Scaduti, 0),
    FallitiAltro = max_of(Falliti - FallitiInesistente - FallitiScaduto - FallitiSubject, 0)
| extend Righe = pack_array(
    bag_pack("Voce", "OTP generati", "Conteggio", Generati),
    bag_pack("Voce", "Subentri completati", "Conteggio", Completati),
    bag_pack("Voce", "Tentativi con OTP scaduto", "Conteggio", Scaduti),
    bag_pack("Voce", "OTP generati e mai usati", "Conteggio", MaiUsati),
    bag_pack("Voce", "Subentri falliti", "Conteggio", Falliti),
    bag_pack("Voce", "↳ di cui OTP inesistente", "Conteggio", FallitiInesistente),
    bag_pack("Voce", "↳ di cui OTP scaduto", "Conteggio", FallitiScaduto),
    bag_pack("Voce", "↳ di cui Service Provider diverso da chi ha generato l'OTP", "Conteggio", FallitiSubject),
    bag_pack("Voce", "↳ di cui altri motivi", "Conteggio", FallitiAltro))
| mv-expand Riga = Righe
| project Voce = tostring(Riga.Voce), Conteggio = tolong(Riga.Conteggio)

azureLogAnalytics.query:
let validOps = 
    AppDependencies
    | where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
    | where Name has "POST /rtpactivator/activations" and Name has "takeover"
    | distinct OperationId;

let deps =
    AppDependencies
    | where Name has "takeover"
    | extend JWT_Subject = tostring(Properties["Request-X-JWT-Subject"])
    | extend activation_id_dep = extract(@"activations/([^/]+)/takeover", 1, Name)
    | summarize JWT_Subject = any(JWT_Subject), activation_id_dep = any(activation_id_dep) by OperationId;

let ex =
    union
        (AppExceptions
         | where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
         | where AppRoleName == "rtp-activator"
         | project OperationId, Livello = toint(4), Testo = InnermostMessage),
        (AppTraces
         | where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
         | where AppRoleName == "rtp-activator"
         | where SeverityLevel >= 2
         | project OperationId, Livello = toint(SeverityLevel), Testo = Message)
    | summarize arg_max(Livello, Testo) by OperationId
    | extend Testo = replace_regex(Testo, @"[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}", "<id>")
    | extend Breve = extract(@"^(WebExchangeBindException: Validation failed for argument at index \d+)", 1, Testo)
    | extend InnermostMessage = iif(isnotempty(Breve), Breve, Testo)
    | project OperationId, InnermostMessage;

let tr =
    AppTraces
    | where AppRoleName == "rtp-activator"
    | extend activation_id_trace = tostring(Properties.activation_id)
    | where isnotempty(activation_id_trace)
    | summarize activation_id_trace = any(activation_id_trace) by OperationId;

AppRequests
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where AppRoleName == "rtp-activator"
| where Name startswith "POST" and Name contains "takeover"
| join kind=inner validOps on OperationId
| where ResultCode != "201" and ResultCode != "409"
| project OperationId, TimeGenerated, Name, ResultCode
| join kind=leftouter deps on OperationId
| join kind=leftouter ex on OperationId
| join kind=leftouter tr on OperationId
| extend JWT_Subject = iif(isempty(JWT_Subject), "UNKNOWN", JWT_Subject)
| extend activation_id = coalesce(activation_id_dep, activation_id_trace, "N/A")
| extend Motivo = iif(isempty(InnermostMessage), "N/A", InnermostMessage)
| where $__contains(JWT_Subject, $activator_subject)
| summarize Conteggio = count() by ["Activation ID"] = activation_id, ["Service Provider"] = JWT_Subject, ["Status Code"] = ResultCode, Motivo
| order by Conteggio desc

azureLogAnalytics.query:
let validOps = 
    AppDependencies
    | where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)

    | distinct OperationId;

let deps =
    AppDependencies
    | where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)

    | extend activation_id = extract(@"activations/([^/]+)", 1, Name)
    | summarize JWT_Subject = any(JWT_Subject), activation_id = any(activation_id) by OperationId;

let ex =
    union
        (AppExceptions
         | where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
         | where AppRoleName == "rtp-activator"
         | project OperationId, Livello = toint(4), Testo = InnermostMessage),
        (AppTraces
         | where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
         | where AppRoleName == "rtp-activator"
         | where SeverityLevel >= 2
         | project OperationId, Livello = toint(SeverityLevel), Testo = Message)
    | summarize arg_max(Livello, Testo) by OperationId
    | extend Testo = replace_regex(Testo, @"[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}", "<id>")
    | extend Breve = extract(@"^(WebExchangeBindException: Validation failed for argument at index \d+)", 1, Testo)
    | extend InnermostMessage = iif(isnotempty(Breve), Breve, Testo)
    | project OperationId, InnermostMessage;

AppRequests
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where AppRoleName == "rtp-activator"
| where Name has "DELETE" and Name contains "activations"
| join kind=inner validOps on OperationId
| where ResultCode == "400"
| project OperationId, TimeGenerated, ResultCode
| join kind=leftouter deps on OperationId
| join kind=leftouter ex on OperationId
| extend JWT_Subject = iif(isempty(JWT_Subject), "UNKNOWN", JWT_Subject)
| where $__contains(JWT_Subject, $activator_subject)
| extend Motivo = iif(isempty(InnermostMessage), "N/A", InnermostMessage)
| extend activation_id = iif(isempty(activation_id), "N/A", activation_id)
| summarize Conteggio = count() by ["Activation ID"] = activation_id, ["Service Provider"] = JWT_Subject, Motivo
| order by Conteggio desc
